column1: # Flash layout for the 8 MB XIAO ESP32-C5. Offsets are explicit so a build can
# never silently move a partition: changing this table cannot be delivered by
# OTA. The bootloader sits at 0x2000 (C5 ROM) and the table at 0x10000
# leaves 0xE000 for the bootloader. The production bootloader is 0xB000 signed.
# Reserved only. Offset comes from CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_RECOVERY_OFFSET
# from the primary bootloader's region. Nothing writes this region yet.
